title: Identification and Estimation of Semiparametric Multilayered Sample Selection Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.25519v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Many selection problems are multilayered, involving both participation and sorting among ordered or unordered categories. Unlike binary selection, in which selection bias can be summarized by a scalar control function, ordered and multinomial sorting generally produce multi-index control functions for which identification depends on both covariate variation and the structure of the selection correction function. I establish identification results for both architectures, showing how nonlinearity in the selection equation can substitute for excluded variables under structural restrictions. I also show how additional structural restrictions reduce the control-function dimension and make estimation practical. I propose $\sqrt{n}$-consistent two-step sieve plug-in estimators and apply the framework to gender wage gaps among Korean college graduates. translated_title: 半参数多层样本选择模型的识别与估计
translated_abstract: 许多选择问题是多层次的，既涉及参与决策，又涉及在有序或无序类别之间的分类选择。与二元选择不同（在二元选择中，选择偏差可以由一个标量控制函数来概括），有序分类和多分类排序通常会产生多指标控制函数，其识别既依赖于协变量的变化，也依赖于选择修正函数的结构。我为这两种模型架构建立了识别结果，展示了在结构约束条件下，选择方程中的非线性可以替代排除变量的作用。我还展示了额外的结构约束如何降低控制函数的维度，从而使估计在实践上可行。我提出了√n一致的两步筛子嵌入估计量，并将该框架应用于韩国大学毕业生的性别工资差距问题。在有序设定下，选择修正显著缩小了所估计的……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文为有序和多分类的多层样本选择模型建立了识别结果，证明在结构约束下选择方程的非线性可替代排除变量，并据此提出√n一致的两步筛子嵌入估计量，且将其应用于韩国大学毕业生性别工资差距的估计。
